room_geometry.observed_evidence: Counter, chairs, floor, walls, windows, door and work surfaces coexist plausibly.

circulation.observed_evidence: A wide clear path remains from entry through waiting area to the public counter.

spatial_anchors.observed_evidence: Warm-wood counter, teal chair rows, daylight windows and rear work area stay stable across the shot.

master_coverage.observed_evidence: Locked wide view establishes entry, waiting hall, counter, both principals and background circulation.

character_count_identity.observed_evidence: Patient and nurse remain distinct while background adults remain non-speaking.

background_population.observed_evidence: The hall reads near the planned sixty percent occupancy and within the acceptable framing range.

crowd_continuity.observed_evidence: Background adults remain seated or quietly active without obvious fusion or impossible crossings.

blocking_and_framing.observed_evidence: Patient remains public-side screen left and moves laterally toward the counter; nurse remains staff-side screen right.

gaze_and_eyeline.observed_evidence: The principals attend to each other/work targets and never address the camera.

anatomy_contact.observed_evidence: Walking, floor contact and the brief elbow/hand gesture remain plausible at wide scale.

wardrobe_construction.observed_evidence: Plain olive outerwear and teal clinical clothing remain stable; no readable badge is evident.

privacy.observed_evidence: No card face, patient identifier or readable monitor content appears.

unwanted_text.observed_evidence: No facility name, logo, malformed lettering, caption or readable screen text is evident.

lighting_continuity.observed_evidence: Soft background window light combines coherently with warm neutral interior light.

performance_action_match.observed_evidence: Patient reads tired but stable and gives one restrained hand-to-elbow/face cough gesture while approaching.

continuity.observed_evidence: The master supplies a coherent public-left/staff-right axis for all planned close coverage.

symbolic_environment.observed_evidence: Ordinary daylight and normal clinic motion carry the tension without expository symbols or text.

monitor_orientation.observed_evidence: Work surfaces remain too distant and oriented away enough that no screen content is readable.

counter_separation.observed_evidence: The full counter clearly separates public and staff zones.
